feature: official grpc-cpp ORCA per-RPC backend load reports

directions: netz client to official grpc-cpp server
official grpc-cpp client to netz server
scope.request: canonical SimpleRequest.orca_per_query_report with cpu=0.8210, memory=0.5847, request_cost[cost]=3456.32, utilization[util]=0.30499
scope.official_client_policy: test_backend_metrics_load_balancer selected by the same loadBalancingConfig used by upstream run_interop_tests.py
scope.oob_boundary: OpenRcaService/StreamCoreMetrics remains a separate feature; a preceding optional watcher receives UNIMPLEMENTED in the per-RPC fixture

reference.implementation: grpc-core C++ interop_client, interop_server, backend metrics filter, parser, and test LB policy

implementation.public_codec: netz.grpc.orca encodes and decodes the complete xds.data.orca.v3.OrcaLoadReport schema without generated bindings, including deprecated integer RPS and all three metric maps
implementation.validation: non-finite scalars, negative nonnegative metrics, memory or utilization fractions outside 0..1, invalid UTF-8 metric names, and duplicate output map keys are rejected
implementation.protobuf_semantics: unknown fields are skipped; repeated scalar and map values use last-value-wins behavior
implementation.metadata_ownership: decoded Base64 and metric indexes are owned together; repeated or comma-combined non-repeatable report values are rejected
implementation.fixture_layout: the canonical grpc.testing.TestOrcaReport codec is isolated under tools/interop/grpc_cpp/orca_messages.zig instead of enlarging the general fixture root
implementation.reverse_runner: orca_per_rpc is one of 26 official client scenarios per transport and uses upstream's required test load-balancing service config
implementation.forward_runner: the persistent netz client sends the canonical report and validates every scalar and map entry returned by the official server

results.reverse_matrix: 26 scenarios per transport, 52 total, passed over h2c and TLS
results.reverse_orca: official grpc-cpp backend-metrics policy accepted the netz endpoint-load-metrics-bin report over h2c and TLS
results.forward_matrix: complete netz-client matrix passed over h2c and TLS, plus pick-first failover
results.forward_orca: netz decoded the official grpc-cpp endpoint-load-metrics-bin report over h2c and certificate-verified TLS

remaining_gap: The canonical per-RPC report is externally covered in both directions. The long-lived OpenRcaService OOB report stream, update cadence, reconnect, and consumer integration remain separate work.
